method.process_policy: fresh isolated rustc per revision; independent persistent on-disk incremental state; one successful unprofiled baseline compile before all rounds
method.time: external compile, test and save-to-result are wall-clock durations, independent of the internal compiler clock; profiling overhead is included, so use a separate unprofiled benchmark for absolute speed
method.activities: measureme cumulative inclusive durations per rustc label, except the two explicitly marked self_time; phases are diagnostic, can overlap or nest, can aggregate across invocations or threads, and must not be summed as a compiler wall-time breakdown; lazy query loads sum per-query exclusive decode times across threads
method.absence: compiler errors may omit downstream activities; missing values are excluded from medians; a zero lazy-query decode means the profile observed none
method.lazy_query_names: rustc may report some cached-query labels as <unknown> with this limited event set; their decode time is included in the total and their identity is not inferred
method.proc_macros: procedural_macro_calls times and counts actual procedural macro executions; derive_macro_outer is a surrounding activity and is not added to it; absent invocation events count as zero
